universities.name: University of Malaya
universities.description: Malaysia's oldest university and consistently its highest-ranked, with roots going back to 1905 (founded in Singapore as the King Edward VII College of Medicine; renamed University of Malaya in 1949 and recognised as a public university in Malaya from 1962). Based in Kuala Lumpur, UM offers a wide range of programmes across multiple faculties. Its International Channel accepts the Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) for most undergraduate programmes, and recognised bachelor's degrees for postgraduate study.

undergraduate: Completion of 12 years of schooling with a Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC), accepted for most programmes through UM's International Channel.
Minimum marks and subjects are set per programme (for example, Engineering: 65% average with at least 60% in Mathematics and Physics; Business Administration: about 70% average).
Qualifications graded on a different scale are assessed by UM through a cross-matching process.
Medicine does not list the HSC as a direct entry route (accepted routes include A-Level, IB and Foundation/Matriculation).
Meeting the requirements makes you eligible to apply; it does not guarantee admission.
postgraduate: Recognised Bachelor's degree with a minimum CGPA of 3.00 (or equivalent).
Some programmes consider a CGPA of 2.50–2.99 if extra criteria are met (for example an interview, relevant work experience or publications).
Degrees from foreign institutions must be recognised in the Malaysian Qualifications Register.
Requirements vary by programme and admission is not guaranteed.

englishRequirements.ielts: 5.0 - 7.0 (varies by programme)
englishRequirements.toefl: 46 - 96 iBT (varies by programme)

notes: UM quotes fees for the whole programme, not per year.
International, 2025/26.

universities.name: Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia
universities.description: Malaysia's national university, founded on 18 May 1970 (it began in Kuala Lumpur and moved to its main campus in Bangi, Selangor, in 1977). A leading public research university offering programmes across sciences, engineering, medicine, law, and social sciences. Its UKM International (UKMi) route accepts the Bangladeshi Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) for undergraduate study, and recognised bachelor's degrees for postgraduate study.

undergraduate: Completion of 12 years of schooling with a Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC), applied through UKM International (UKMi).

Admission is not guaranteed.

universities.name: University of Barcelona
universities.description: Catalonia's largest public university, founded in 1450 and based in Barcelona. Most degrees are taught in Spanish or Catalan; a limited set of bachelor's and master's programmes (for example International Business and several master's in Economics, Business and Life Sciences) are taught in English.

undergraduate: Bangladeshi HSC (12 years of schooling) is not in a Spain agreement system, so the usual route is homologation of the HSC to the Spanish Título de Bachiller through the Spanish Ministry of Education (the Ministry publishes an equivalence sheet for Bangladesh); the homologated mark is then used as the access grade in the Catalan university pre-enrolment (the UNEDasiss PCE exams are optional, to raise the grade).
Subject prerequisites apply per degree.
Bangladesh GPA-to-Spanish grade conversion is not stated here and must be confirmed.
UB follows the Catalan pre-enrolment system; confirm the current non-EU procedure with UB.
Spanish- or Catalan-taught degrees also require proof of Spanish/Catalan.
postgraduate: Recognised 4-year Bachelor's (Honours) degree in a relevant field; non-EU degrees do not need prior homologation to apply, but the diploma and transcripts must be legalised (Apostille or diplomatic route) for enrolment.
Each master's sets its own minimum grade and documents (not confirmed here).

englishRequirements.ielts: Only for English-taught programmes; level set per programme (B2 is typical, about IELTS 5.5 – 6.5). Not required for Spanish/Catalan-taught degrees.
englishRequirements.toefl: B2 equivalent (about 72 – 94 iBT) where a certificate is requested

universities.name: Pompeu Fabra University
universities.description: A public university in Barcelona founded in 1990, strong in economics, social sciences, law, communication and ICT. Offers seven bachelor's degrees in English (including Global Studies and International Business Economics) and several English-taught master's programmes. Non-EU students pay much higher fees than EU students.

undergraduate: Bangladeshi HSC (12 years of schooling) is not in a Spain agreement system, so the usual route is homologation of the HSC to the Spanish Título de Bachiller through the Spanish Ministry of Education (the Ministry publishes an equivalence sheet for Bangladesh); the homologated mark is then used as the access grade in the Catalan university pre-enrolment (the UNEDasiss PCE exams are optional, to raise the grade).
Subject prerequisites apply per degree.
Bangladesh GPA-to-Spanish grade conversion is not stated here and must be confirmed.
UPF applies the Catalan system; confirm the current non-EU procedure and deadlines with UPF.
postgraduate: Recognised 4-year Bachelor's (Honours) degree in a relevant field.
UPF states that a non-EU degree not yet homologated carries an extra enrolment fee (EUR 218.15 in 2025/26).
Each master's sets its own admission criteria (not confirmed here).

UIC also runs its own admission process (application, and for some degrees a test and personal interview).
Bangladesh GPA conversion is not stated here.
postgraduate: Recognised Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; each master's has its own admission process and documents (not confirmed here).

englishRequirements.toefl: B2 equivalent (about 72 – 94 iBT) accepted where a certificate is requested

universities.name: Université Paris-Saclay
universities.description: A large public research university south of Paris, created in its current form in 2020, with a strong focus on science and engineering, life sciences and health, and economics and management. Undergraduate Licence programmes are taught in French, while the university lists a wide range of Master's programmes taught in English, including Artificial Intelligence, Economics, Physics, Chemistry and International Business and Sustainability.
accreditation: French Ministry of Higher Education and Research (national degrees)

undergraduate: Bangladesh does not appear on the published list of 'Études en France' (EEF) countries, so a Bangladeshi HSC (12 years) holder living in Bangladesh does not use Parcoursup (reserved for French/European baccalauréat and EU/EEA applicants) or the EEF platform for first-year entry. The route for the first year of a Licence (L1) is the DAP blanche (Demande d'Admission Préalable), generally filed between 1 October and 15 December of the year before entry (15 December 2026 for September 2027 entry; confirm dates with the French Embassy / Campus France Bangladesh).
Entry to the 2nd or 3rd year of a Licence goes through the university's own platform (eCandidat or equivalent).
Campus France Bangladesh (Dhaka) must be contacted first for the long-stay student visa.
Paris-Saclay confirms that a DAP is required for L1 for applicants with a non-French/non-European school diploma.
Its Licences are taught in French; French proficiency (final target B2) with a TEF/TCF-type test is required for first-time undergraduate applicants.
No English-taught Licence was identified on the official pages (not exhaustively checked).
HSC subject requirements and GPA conversion are not stated and are decided by the university.
postgraduate: Bangladesh is not an EEF country, so for the first year of a Master's (M1) Bangladeshi applicants use the national platform Mon Master (monmaster.gouv.fr) or the university's own application platform; M2 and PhD applications go directly to the university or doctoral school.
Campus France Bangladesh must be contacted first for the student visa.

Paris-Saclay states that applicants from non-EEF countries apply on its INCEPTION platform for the Master's programmes on its INCEPTION list, and on monmaster.gouv.fr for M1 programmes not on that list.
Applicants not enrolled in French higher education in the last two academic years must give two academic referees.
A 3-year Bachelor's (180 ECTS) is the usual minimum for M1; recognition of the 4-year Bangladeshi Honours degree and any M2 entry are assessed by each programme (not confirmed here).

englishRequirements.ielts: Only for English-taught Master's programmes; level is set per programme (B2, about IELTS 5.5 – 6.5, is typical; exact score not confirmed). No English test for French-taught Licences, which require French instead (B2).
englishRequirements.toefl: B2 equivalent (about 72 – 94 iBT) where a certificate is requested; to be confirmed per programme

fees.note: Non-EU students, 2026/27 (national rate EUR 178). Paris-Saclay's policy (Board resolution CA-2026-013) offers eligible non-EU students a partial exemption down to the national rate, but its 2026/27 exemption procedure was not yet published and exemptions are now capped nationally at 30%
Non-EU students, 2026/27 (national rate EUR 255), with the same partial-exemption policy and national cap; some specific Master's have specific fees set by the Board (resolution CA-2026-014)

scholarships: International Master's Scholarship: EUR 10,000 per year paid monthly from September to June, open to admitted international students in M1 and M2 and renewable from M1 to M2 (application must be made by the set deadline after applying to the Master's; cannot be combined with Eiffel, Europa or Erasmus Mundus scholarships).
The French Government's Eiffel Excellence Scholarship (Master's and PhD) is also supported via Campus France.

universities.name: Université Grenoble Alpes
universities.description: A large public research university in the French Alps, in its current form since January 2020 (an Initiative of Excellence university). UGA reports around 70 Master's programmes taught in English, including joint programmes with Grenoble INP–Ensimag in informatics, artificial intelligence and applied mathematics, as well as Chemistry and Nanosciences. Most Licence programmes are taught in French, with a selective International Biology pathway taught mostly in English.
accreditation: French Ministry of Higher Education and Research (national degrees)

undergraduate: Bangladesh does not appear on the published list of 'Études en France' (EEF) countries, so a Bangladeshi HSC (12 years) holder living in Bangladesh does not use Parcoursup (reserved for French/European baccalauréat and EU/EEA applicants) or the EEF platform for first-year entry. The route for the first year of a Licence (L1) is the DAP blanche (Demande d'Admission Préalable), generally filed between 1 October and 15 December of the year before entry (15 December 2026 for September 2027 entry; confirm dates with the French Embassy / Campus France Bangladesh).
Entry to the 2nd or 3rd year of a Licence goes through the university's own platform (eCandidat or equivalent).
Campus France Bangladesh (Dhaka) must be contacted first for the long-stay student visa.
UGA publishes a yearly list of first-year Licences open to DAP applicants, with a minimum French level set per Licence; check that the chosen Licence is on the 2027/28 list.
French-taught Licences need French proficiency (TCF is compulsory for the DAP blanche, with exceptions).
HSC subject requirements and GPA conversion are not stated and are decided by UGA.
postgraduate: Bangladesh is not an EEF country, so for the first year of a Master's (M1) Bangladeshi applicants use the national platform Mon Master (monmaster.gouv.fr) or the university's own application platform; M2 and PhD applications go directly to the university or doctoral school.
Campus France Bangladesh must be contacted first for the student visa.

For the Ensimag/UGA joint Master's (MoSIG, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics), non-local students apply on the Grenoble INP application platform, which opens in January 2027 (apply by the end of March 2027 if a visa is needed); selection is on transcripts, cover letter, up to three recommendation letters and an English test, with monthly admission committees from February to July 2027 (provisional).
Minimum 3-year Bachelor's (180 ECTS) for the 2-year programmes; a 4-year Bachelor's (240 ECTS) or equivalent for direct M2 entry.
Other UGA Master's (Chemistry, Nanosciences) set their own requirements.

englishRequirements.ielts: Ensimag/UGA joint Master's: IELTS Academic 6.0 (also accepted: PTE Academic 62, Cambridge C1/C2, TOEIC 4-skills 700); an English medium-of-instruction certificate is not accepted. Chemistry Master's: B2 level.
englishRequirements.toefl: TOEFL iBT 78 (Ensimag/UGA joint Master's); B2 equivalent for other English-taught programmes

fees.note: New non-EU students, 2026/27 (national rate EUR 178). 2026/27 is a UGA 'transition year': exemption is granted on request with a declaration of financial resources, and UGA intends to grant it widely within the legal cap. From 2027/28 UGA applies the new decree rules (case-by-case exemption based on social and financial circumstances), so September 2027 entrants may pay the differentiated fee
New non-EU students, 2026/27 (national rate EUR 255 if exempt)
All students pay EUR 255 in 2026/27 (M1 students will be subject to the new UGA rules in M2)

scholarships: UGA IdEx Master Scholarship for international students (one year, partially funded, renewable by new application for the second year; the 2025/26 call was published, so check for the 2027/28 call).
GRAL Master 2 scholarships for chemistry, biology and health Master's (2026/27 call was for candidates who did not do their Bachelor's in Grenoble; future calls to be confirmed).

universities.description: A large public research university in Strasbourg, founded in 1538 and part of the Eucor European Campus and the LERU network. Most Licence programmes are taught in French, while the university offers a list of Master's programmes taught in English, including Chemistry, Computer Science, Mathematics and Applications, Materials Science and Earth and Planetary Sciences.
accreditation: French Ministry of Higher Education and Research (national degrees)

undergraduate: Bangladesh does not appear on the published list of 'Études en France' (EEF) countries, so a Bangladeshi HSC (12 years) holder living in Bangladesh does not use Parcoursup (reserved for French/European baccalauréat and EU/EEA applicants) or the EEF platform for first-year entry. The route for the first year of a Licence (L1) is the DAP blanche (Demande d'Admission Préalable), generally filed between 1 October and 15 December of the year before entry (15 December 2026 for September 2027 entry; confirm dates with the French Embassy / Campus France Bangladesh).
Entry to the 2nd or 3rd year of a Licence goes through the university's own platform (eCandidat or equivalent).
Campus France Bangladesh (Dhaka) must be contacted first for the long-stay student visa.
Unistra lists first-year admission through Parcoursup or the DAP procedure; for a non-EEF country the DAP blanche applies.
Admission to years 2 and 3 of a Licence is through Études en France, eCandidat or Mon Master depending on the programme and the applicant's country.
Most Licences are taught in French and need French proficiency (level set per programme, usually B2).
HSC subject requirements and GPA conversion are not stated and are decided by the university.

Campus France Bangladesh must be contacted first for the student visa.

Unistra lists Études en France (for EEF countries), eCandidat and Mon Master for the first and second years of Master's; for Bangladesh, M1 is expected to go through Mon Master and M2 through eCandidat or the programme platform (confirm per programme).

universities.name: Aix-Marseille University
universities.description: One of the largest French public universities, formed in 2012 by merging the three Aix-Marseille universities, with campuses in Marseille and Aix-en-Provence. Most programmes are taught in French; AMU also lists a set of English-taught degrees, including a 3-year Bachelor's in Economics and Management (IPEM) and Master's programmes in economics, management, biology, nanosciences and more.
accreditation: French Ministry of Higher Education and Research (national degrees)

undergraduate: Bangladesh does not appear on the published list of 'Études en France' (EEF) countries, so a Bangladeshi HSC (12 years) holder living in Bangladesh does not use Parcoursup (reserved for French/European baccalauréat and EU/EEA applicants) or the EEF platform for first-year entry. The route for the first year of a Licence (L1) is the DAP blanche (Demande d'Admission Préalable), generally filed between 1 October and 15 December of the year before entry (15 December 2026 for September 2027 entry; confirm dates with the French Embassy / Campus France Bangladesh).
Entry to the 2nd or 3rd year of a Licence goes through the university's own platform (eCandidat or equivalent).
Campus France Bangladesh (Dhaka) must be contacted first for the long-stay student visa.

AMU's IPEM programme states the same logic: applicants living outside France in a country not covered by Études en France use the DAP blanche submitted to the French embassy in their country; its transcripts must be in English (or certified translations), and the admissions committee decides whether a foreign diploma such as the HSC is equivalent to the baccalauréat.
French-taught Licences need French proficiency.
HSC subject requirements and GPA conversion are not stated.
postgraduate: Bangladesh is not an EEF country, so for the first year of a Master's (M1) Bangladeshi applicants use the national platform Mon Master (monmaster.gouv.fr) or the university's own application platform; M2 and PhD applications go directly to the university or doctoral school.
Campus France Bangladesh must be contacted first for the student visa.
Admission for AMU Master's is programme-specific; English-taught Master's are listed on AMU's 'Courses Taught in English' page, and some are only partly in English with French B2 required.
A 3-year Bachelor's (180 ECTS) is the usual minimum for M1; recognition of the Bangladeshi 4-year Honours degree is assessed by each programme.

englishRequirements.ielts: IPEM Bachelor's: no certificate required (English level of the French baccalauréat is sufficient) and no French needed. English-taught Master's: level set per programme (B2, about IELTS 5.5 – 6.5, is typical; exact score not confirmed). Some AMU programmes are only partly in English and require French B2.
englishRequirements.toefl: B2 equivalent (about 72 – 94 iBT) where a certificate is requested; to be confirmed per programme

fees.note: New non-EU students, 2026/27, payable in full on enrolment (no instalments); AMU applies the exemptions in the national rules (for example French Government scholarship holders) but no general partial exemption for first-time non-EU students

scholarships: AMU lists TIGER Master's Excellence Scholarships and institute-level scholarships for some Master's (for example ISFIN for students new to AMU in an instrumentation Master's); amounts and eligibility were not confirmed from AMU's own pages.

universities.name: University of Bordeaux
universities.description: A large public research university in south-west France with historical roots dating back to 1441. It lists around 70 international study programmes and more than 25 Master's programmes taught entirely in English, in economics and management, health, chemistry, neuroscience, mathematics and engineering. Most Licence programmes are taught in French.
accreditation: French Ministry of Higher Education and Research (national degrees)

undergraduate: Bangladesh does not appear on the published list of 'Études en France' (EEF) countries, so a Bangladeshi HSC (12 years) holder living in Bangladesh does not use Parcoursup (reserved for French/European baccalauréat and EU/EEA applicants) or the EEF platform for first-year entry. The route for the first year of a Licence (L1) is the DAP blanche (Demande d'Admission Préalable), generally filed between 1 October and 15 December of the year before entry (15 December 2026 for September 2027 entry; confirm dates with the French Embassy / Campus France Bangladesh).
Entry to the 2nd or 3rd year of a Licence goes through the university's own platform (eCandidat or equivalent).
Campus France Bangladesh (Dhaka) must be contacted first for the long-stay student visa.

Bordeaux also runs an International Bachelor Degree Programme in Chemistry (some scientific courses in English, compulsory mobility) that is advertised via Parcoursup for baccalauréat holders; whether it is open to DAP applicants was not confirmed.
Most Licences are taught in French and need French proficiency.
HSC subject requirements and GPA conversion are not stated and are decided by the university.
postgraduate: Bangladesh is not an EEF country, so for the first year of a Master's (M1) Bangladeshi applicants use the national platform Mon Master (monmaster.gouv.fr) or the university's own application platform; M2 and PhD applications go directly to the university or doctoral school.

Bordeaux notes that for EEF countries almost all its English-taught Master's are on the Études en France platform (deadline 19 January for 2026 entry); for a non-EEF country such as Bangladesh, M1 applications are expected via Mon Master (mid-February to mid-March in 2026) and M2 via the programme's own process (confirm per programme).

universities.name: Trinity College Dublin
universities.description: Ireland's oldest university, founded in 1592 and based in the centre of Dublin. It offers four-year undergraduate degrees (Computer Science and Engineering include an optional fifth postgraduate year) and taught and research postgraduate degrees, all taught in English. Bangladeshi HSC holders cannot start a degree directly: Trinity's route for HSC is the one-year International Foundation Programme.

undergraduate: Direct undergraduate entry for international students requires a school-leaving qualification such as A-levels or the International Baccalaureate; the Bangladeshi HSC is not listed for direct entry.

Trinity's published route for HSC holders is the International Foundation Programme (IFP): HSC 70% or above including key subjects, with at least 50% in relevant subjects (Maths and sciences). The IFP is a 1-year pathway taught at Marino Institute of Education in Dublin, and students who pass with the required grades progress to year 1 of their chosen Trinity degree. IFP applications go directly to Trinity (IFP@tcd.ie); older IFP brochures listed tuition of EUR 16,480 (business/social sciences pathway) and EUR 17,995 (science pathway), current figures to be confirmed.
Degree applicants then need an Irish study visa (INIS) after an offer.
Meeting the requirements does not guarantee admission.
postgraduate: Generally a good honours bachelor's degree (about an Irish 2.1 or international equivalent); Bangladeshi applicants should expect to need a 4-year bachelor's degree.
Trinity's Bangladesh country page lists accepted equivalents but the grade conversion is not confirmed here, and each course sets its own requirements.

englishRequirements.ielts: Typically 6.5 overall for degree courses (band-based, some courses higher); Foundation Programme: 5.0 overall (5.0 in writing, no element below 4.5)
englishRequirements.toefl: About 88 iBT for degree entry (tests before January 2026; confirm, as TOEFL changed scoring from 21 January 2026); Foundation Programme: 64 with at least 16 in each section

universities.name: University College Dublin
universities.description: Ireland's largest university, with its main campus at Belfield in south Dublin and origins in 1854. It has six colleges (Arts and Humanities, Business, Engineering and Architecture, Health and Agricultural Sciences, Science, Social Sciences and Law) and teaches its undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in English.

undergraduate: Per UCD Global's Bangladesh page, the Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC), Intermediate Certificate or Alim must be combined with 2 years of a bachelor's degree at a recognised university with acceptable grades, or with the UCD International Foundation Year (run with a partner study centre, available for many programmes).
Cambridge A-levels and IB are also accepted.
International (non-EU fee) applicants apply directly to UCD, while applicants with EU fee status apply through the CAO.
Programme prerequisites apply (for example Mathematics, and a lab science for Engineering and Science), but Bangladesh-specific minimum grades are not published; contact UCD Global.
Meeting the requirements makes you eligible to be considered and does not guarantee admission.

Programme-specific requirements apply.

universities.name: Seoul National University
universities.description: Korea's flagship national university, founded in 1946 on the Gwanak campus in Seoul, with colleges covering humanities, social sciences, natural sciences, engineering, business, medicine, nursing and more. Foreign undergraduate applicants apply through International Admission I or II and are selected by document review. Most undergraduate teaching is in Korean, with English courses varying by department, so Bangladeshi applicants should plan for Korean-language study.
accreditation: Korea Institute of Medical Education and Evaluation (KIMEE, College of Medicine)
Korean Accreditation Board of Nursing Education (College of Nursing)

undergraduate: Foreign applicants apply under International Admission I (applicant and both parents non-Korean, nationality held before high school) or II (entire schooling outside Korea).

SNU asks for completion of a government-accredited course equivalent to Korean high school by 28 February of the entry year; the Bangladesh HSC is not named and no HSC grade or GPA conversion is published, so HSC eligibility should be confirmed with the Office of Admissions (snuadmit@snu.ac.kr).
Selection is by document review (personal statement and study plan, recommendation letters, transcripts, language proof); some departments add interviews or tests.
Proof of Korean or English proficiency is required.

Bangladesh joined the Apostille Convention on 30 March 2025, so the HSC certificate and transcript should carry a Bangladesh apostille (private-school or board copies may need notarisation first); documents not in English or Korean need a notarised translation.
The latest guide I could open covers March 2023 entry (online application in early July the year before, fee KRW 70,000); a September intake was not confirmed. Check the current cycle.
Meeting the requirements does not guarantee admission.
postgraduate: SNU runs separate international graduate admissions (Spring and Fall guides).
Applicants need a bachelor's degree or recognised equivalent from an accredited institution by the entry date and must meet SNU's nationality rules.
A Bangladesh-specific route, CGPA requirement and fees were not verified here; check the current Graduate Admissions Guide.

undergraduate: Eligible applicants hold non-Korean citizenship and graduate from high school by 28 February 2027 (Spring entry, Early track only) or 31 August 2027 (Fall entry, Early or Regular track).

universities.name: University of Toronto
universities.description: One of Canada's leading research universities, founded in 1827, with three campuses: St. George (downtown Toronto), Mississauga and Scarborough. It offers undergraduate, professional and graduate degrees across Arts & Science, Applied Science & Engineering, Rotman Commerce, Architecture, Kinesiology, Music and more. All programmes listed here are taught in English. U of T's high-school requirements page lists the Bangladeshi Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) as an accepted credential, with competitive entry and programme-specific subject prerequisites.
accreditation: Ontario public university (degree-granting authority under provincial legislation)
Designated Learning Institution (DLI) for study permits

undergraduate: Direct first-year entry from the Bangladeshi Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC, 12 years of study) is listed on U of T's high-school requirements by country.

Admission is competitive and based on overall grades plus programme subject prerequisites (for example Mathematics for Computer Science and Commerce; Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry and English for Engineering; confirm each list on future.utoronto.ca). U of T does not publish an HSC GPA-to-percentage conversion on the pages checked, so the competitive HSC range is not confirmed here.
Some programmes add components (for example an admission profile for Engineering or a supplementary application for Rotman Commerce).
Meeting the requirements does not guarantee admission.

After an offer: apply to IRCC for a study permit with the letter of acceptance, proof of funds (CAD 22,895 for living costs for a single applicant from 1 September 2025, reviewed yearly by IRCC, plus first-year tuition and return travel), a Provincial Attestation Letter (PAL) from Ontario for most undergraduate applicants, and biometrics at a VFS Global centre in Bangladesh (study permit fee CAD 150, biometrics CAD 85). The Student Direct Stream closed in November 2024, so Bangladeshi applicants use the regular stream. Check IRCC for the current amounts and processing times.
postgraduate: Generally a four-year bachelor's degree (a Bangladeshi four-year Honours/BSc or equivalent) with at least a B+ average in the final year, which is the School of Graduate Studies minimum; programmes set their own, often higher, requirements, deadlines and supporting documents. The conversion of Bangladeshi grades to U of T's scale was not confirmed.

Master's and doctoral students at public Canadian universities have been exempt from the PAL requirement since 1 January 2026, but still need a letter of acceptance, proof of funds, a study permit and biometrics.

TOEFL iBT scoring changed on 21 January 2026 (new 6-point scale), so confirm current TOEFL thresholds on the university page.

universities.description: One of Canada's leading research universities, founded in 1908, with its main campus (Vancouver) on the Point Grey peninsula; the separate Okanagan campus in Kelowna is not covered here. UBC Vancouver has faculties including Applied Science (Engineering), Science, Arts, the Sauder School of Business and many professional schools. All programmes listed here are taught in English. The Bangladesh subject list and UBC's grading-scale conversion could not be read here, so prerequisites and the competitive HSC range are unverified; confirm on you.ubc.ca.

universities.name: McGill University
universities.description: One of Canada's oldest and most internationally ranked universities, founded in 1821 in Montreal, Quebec, with a downtown campus and the Macdonald Campus (agriculture and environment). Instruction is in English, and French is not required for most programmes (Nursing requires proof of French proficiency). McGill lists the Bangladeshi Intermediate/Higher Secondary School Certificate (First Division) as an accepted pre-university credential for direct entry. Quebec has its own immigration step (the CAQ) on top of the federal study permit.
accreditation: Quebec public university (recognised by the Ministere de l'Enseignement superieur)
Designated Learning Institution (DLI) for study permits

undergraduate: McGill accepts the Intermediate/Higher Secondary School Certificate (First Division) from Bangladesh.

The minimum is the equivalent of a B+ average and most programmes ask for more; prerequisite subjects must be completed in the last two years (Science: Mathematics at pre-calculus level and normally two of biology, chemistry or physics; Engineering: Mathematics, Chemistry and Physics; Management: Mathematics; Arts: none). The HSC-to-B+ conversion is not published on the pages checked.

For international applicants with other international high-school credentials, the application deadline is 15 January and supporting documents are due 1 March; the Major Entrance Scholarship deadline is 21 January.
Applicants from a system with fewer pre-university years may be placed in a longer programme; confirm programme length.

After an offer: obtain a Quebec Acceptance Certificate (CAQ) from Quebec immigration, then apply to IRCC for a study permit with proof of funds and biometrics at a VFS Global centre in Bangladesh (study permit fee CAD 150, biometrics CAD 85).

Quebec's cap procedures and financial-proof amounts differ from the rest of Canada (the federal CAD 22,895 figure applies outside Quebec), so confirm with Quebec immigration and IRCC. The Student Direct Stream closed in November 2024.
postgraduate: A four-year bachelor's degree (for Bangladesh, a four-year Honours/BSc or equivalent) with a strong cumulative GPA, generally at least 3.0/4.0, with programme-specific minimums that are often higher. The conversion of Bangladeshi grades was not confirmed.

Master's and doctoral students at public Canadian universities have been exempt from the PAL requirement since 1 January 2026, but still need a letter of acceptance, proof of funds, a study permit and biometrics. Quebec's CAQ is still required.

universities.name: University of Oxford
universities.description: A collegiate public research university in Oxford, England, with teaching recorded since 1096. Undergraduates belong to one of the colleges and are taught mainly through tutorials. Applications go through UCAS with an earlier mid-October deadline than most universities, plus admissions tests and interviews for most courses. All programmes listed here are taught in English. Oxford does not accept the Bangladeshi Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) for undergraduate entry, so Bangladeshi applicants need A-levels, the IB or another qualification on Oxford's accepted list.
accreditation: Registered with the Office for Students (OfS)
Licensed Student sponsor (UK Visas and Immigration)

undergraduate: Oxford's own international qualifications list marks the Bangladeshi Higher Secondary School Certificate (HSC) as not accepted for undergraduate entry, so it cannot meet an Oxford offer. Bangladeshi applicants need A-levels (for example Edexcel, which Oxford accepts), the International Baccalaureate or another qualification on Oxford's list; Oxford does not accept transfer students.

Typical offers are set course by course on Oxford's course pages, and most courses require an admissions test (for example the Engineering and Science Admissions Test, ESAT, for Engineering Science), sometimes written work, and an interview.
Apply through UCAS by the mid-October deadline, earlier than the general January deadline.
Meeting the requirements does not guarantee an offer.
After an unconditional offer (and any tuition deposit) the university issues a CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) for the Student visa.

Proof of funds is first-year tuition (less anything already paid) plus living costs of £1,203 per month outside London for up to 9 months from 30 November 2026 (£1,171 before that date), held for 28 consecutive days.
The visa fee is £558 and the Immigration Health Surcharge is £776 per year of the visa.
Bangladeshi applicants must also take a tuberculosis (TB) test at a UKVI-approved clinic in Bangladesh and complete identity checks/biometrics.
Some science, engineering and computing courses (especially at master's level) may need an ATAS certificate.
Check gov.uk and the university's visa pages for current amounts.
postgraduate: Oxford publishes country-by-country guidance for graduate applicants.

DPhil applicants usually also need a research proposal.

universities.description: Finland's oldest and largest university, a research-intensive public university in Helsinki that traces its history to 1640 and has 11 faculties. English-language degrees are offered through the Bachelor's Programme in Science and more than 30 international master's programmes; most other bachelor's programmes are taught in Finnish or Swedish. Non-EU/EEA students pay tuition fees for English-taught degrees, and applications go through the national Studyinfo portal.
accreditation: Public university under the Finnish Universities Act

undergraduate: At bachelor's level, new applicants can apply in English only to the Bachelor's Programme in Science.

Applicants with a Bangladeshi HSC are in Admission Group 1 (application period 5-19 January 2027), where admission is based on SAT or ACT scores; the minimum scores are published in the admission criteria on Studyinfo.fi and were not confirmed here.
The HSC should count as an upper secondary qualification giving university eligibility, but the Bangladesh-specific entry on Helsinki's eligibility page was not confirmed.
No HSC grade conversion is published and the HSC grade is not used for ranking.
Non-EU/EEA applicants pay a one-time national application fee of EUR 100 through Studyinfo (no waiver; it covers all applications for the same term).

After an offer: apply for the first residence permit for studies online through Enter Finland (Migri) from outside Finland. Migri lists the first-permit fee as EUR 600 online (EUR 750 on paper), and you must show EUR 9,600 for the first year (EUR 800 per month) in addition to the tuition fee, plus valid health insurance and an in-person identity check at a service point (confirm the Bangladesh service point and current fees on migri.fi). A study permit allows work averaging about 30 hours a week.
Meeting the requirements does not guarantee admission.
postgraduate: Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) that gives eligibility for master's studies in the country where it was awarded, plus applicable prior studies for the chosen programme and proof of English.
Diploma-level qualifications do not give eligibility.

For Bangladesh, conditionally admitted applicants who cannot submit electronically verified documents must send copies of the degree certificate and transcript attested by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Bangladesh (Consular and Welfare Wing), and documents issued by affiliated colleges are not accepted (the awarding main university or a degree-awarding college must issue them).
Whether a three-year Bangladeshi bachelor's degree is accepted was not confirmed; a four-year honours degree is the safer route.

universities.name: University of Malta
universities.description: Malta's national public university, based on the Msida campus and tracing its origins to the Jesuit Collegium Melitense of 1592 (it became the University of Malta in 1769). It teaches in English across a wide range of faculties and runs an International School for Foundation Studies for overseas students who do not yet meet degree entry requirements. Bangladeshi HSC holders are pointed to its foundation certificates rather than direct bachelor's entry.
accreditation: Programmes pegged to the Malta Qualifications Framework and recognised by the Malta Further and Higher Education Authority (MFHEA)

undergraduate: Bangladesh HSC: not accepted for direct entry into bachelor's degrees.

UM's country page for Bangladesh says HSC holders may apply for pathway programmes at the International School for Foundation Studies (Certificates in Foundation Studies, one year, 62 ECTS, MQF Level 4); entry is at the School's sole discretion, and completing a certificate makes you eligible to apply for specific UM degrees (some guarantee a place, others, such as Applied Food and Nutritional Sciences, have limited seats).

A valid SELT must be submitted by the deadline or you will not be admitted: October intake 1 July (applicants who need a visa) or 30 September; February intake 30 October (visa applicants) or 31 January.
No HSC grade conversion is published by this institution.

After an offer: Bangladeshi applicants need a long-stay student (D) visa from Identita's Central Visa Unit, lodged through VFS Global in Bangladesh (visa fee EUR 100 standard or EUR 150 extended service, plus a VFS service charge listed as BDT 13,935 or BDT 20,900; a rise to EUR 300 / EUR 400 from 2027 has been reported and is unconfirmed). Expect to show the acceptance letter and first tuition payment, accommodation, private health insurance and three months of bank statements proving funds (a third party quotes about EUR 780 a month).
After arrival apply for an e-Residence permit within 90 days; non-EU students may work up to 20 hours a week once they hold it, and 75% attendance is needed to keep the visa.
Confirm current fees and checklists with Identita and VFS.
postgraduate: A bachelor's degree at a certain classification or GPA depending on the course (listed per course on UM's Course Finder); applications for master's courses are assessed case by case once a complete application is received.
Whether a three-year Bangladeshi bachelor's degree is accepted was not confirmed, so check the course page or ask UM's International Office.
A SELT result is required (deadlines as for undergraduate applicants; master's by research and PhD applicants submit it before starting).

After an offer: Bangladeshi applicants need a long-stay student (D) visa from Identita's Central Visa Unit, lodged through VFS Global in Bangladesh (visa fee EUR 100 standard or EUR 150 extended service, plus a VFS service charge listed as BDT 13,935 or BDT 20,900; a rise to EUR 300 / EUR 400 from 2027 has been reported and is unconfirmed). universities.name: National and Kapodistrian University of Athens
universities.description: Greece's oldest university, founded in 1837 and based in Athens, with around 9 schools and 40+ departments. Its undergraduate degrees are mostly taught in Greek, but it runs a growing list of English-taught programmes: a BA in ancient Greek studies, an English Medical Degree and more than 15 English master's programmes in sciences, data, law and social sciences.
accreditation: Public university under Greek law; programmes accredited by the Hellenic Authority for Higher Education (HAHE)

undergraduate: Greek-taught undergraduate route (free of tuition): non-EU applicants, including Bangladeshi HSC holders, apply through the Greek Ministry of Education's central process for foreign candidates (online information system exams-foreigner.it.minedu.gov.gr, a single application week in July, followed by posting the original documents; the 2026 postmark deadline was 10 July).

The school-leaving certificate (HSC, with SSC) must be validated by the competent authority in Bangladesh and the Greek embassy/Ministry of Foreign Affairs, with an official Greek translation, and applicants must prove Greek at B2 level (a Greek-language preparatory year is the usual way to reach it).
The ranking and selection criteria for foreign candidates were not confirmed here and no official HSC grade conversion was found.

English-taught bachelor's programmes (fee-paying) are applied for directly with each programme: school-leaving certificate and transcripts, English certificate, personal statement, sometimes an interview.
Bangladeshi HSC holders are accepted only where the programme says so (AUTH's Sport and Exercise Sciences BSc names HSC science stream); check each programme.

The Medical Degree in English (MEDICEn) accepts the International Baccalaureate, A-levels, AP plus SAT, UCAT and similar qualifications, or a cognate BSc, and is open only to applicants who attended the last two years of high school outside Greece; the HSC is not one of the listed routes.
Admitted MEDICEn applicants pay EUR 5,000 to secure a place.
Non-EU students need a national student visa (Type D) and residence permit, with proof of admission, financial means and health insurance.
